reason: Implementation proof exposed two existing PLAT-005 runtime facts that the preparation documents did not make explicit.

facts.fact: HrisAuditOutboxEventV1 outcome is an operation result, while sys_audit_events.policy_decision accepts ALLOW, DENY or NOT_APPLICABLE.
facts.resolution: The adapter maps DENIED to DENY and SUCCESS or FAILED to ALLOW. FAILED remains an allowed operation whose execution failed; it is not a denied authorization decision.
facts.repositoryRule: Canonical HCM evidence requires DENIED+DENY or SUCCESS/FAILED+ALLOW and rejects NULL or mismatched policy_decision.

facts.fact: AuditRiskEngine may promote a privileged denied HRIS event from HIGH to CRITICAL before durable ingestion.
facts.resolution: The closed HCM projection accepts CRITICAL only for denied canonical evidence. The frontend typed parser and filter accept CRITICAL; LOW and MEDIUM remain fail-closed.

nonChanges: No change to HrisAuditOutboxEventV1 wire fields.
No new audit table, ingestion path, migration or HRIS-local store.
No weakening of tenant, purpose, field-policy, SoD or ELEVATED authority checks.

proof.postgresEndToEnd: HrisAuditOutboxEventV1 -> adapter -> risk engine -> sys_audit_events -> HCM repository PASS
